source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school assessment paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Header printed: 'GRADE VII  SCHOOL  PHYSICS / TIME 2 HOURS  ASSESSMENT-II  MM. 40' ('SCHOOL' stands in for the school name). No year is printed; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name and its icseboard.org folder (…/physics/2023/). Section A (20 marks, attempt all): I) eight true/false items [4], II) eight-pair matching [4], III) eight MCQs [4], IV) five one-word items [5], V) two definitions (3). Items worth half a mark cannot be stored (marks must be whole numbers): I), II) and V) are kept as single entries with their printed totals; the eight MCQs of III) are separate entries stored at 1 mark each although the printed [4] gives them ½ mark each (flagged per item). Section B (20 marks) says 'Attempt any Four questions (each question carry 2.5 marks)' over six questions, which conflicts with 20 marks for four questions; each question (parts a and b kept together because the part marks are not printed) is stored at 5 marks = 20/4, and flagged. Section B restarts its numbering at I), so its entries use numbers 'B-I' … 'B-VI'. Marks in this file total 54 against the printed 40 (half-mark rounding in III and the pick-4-of-6 choice). Pen ticks and a pen strike-through on the scan were ignored. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
